rules.text: IF stream is blank THEN add 'Intermediate / A-Level stream' to the missing list.
IF Inter % is blank or outside pct_min..pct_max THEN add 'Intermediate marks (%)' to the missing list.
IF Matric % is blank or outside pct_min..pct_max THEN add 'Matric / O-Level marks (%)' to the missing list.
IF budget is blank THEN add 'Budget' to the missing list.
IF fewer than min_answered interest and skill questions are answered THEN add 'Interest and skills questions' to the missing list.
IF the missing list is not empty THEN the result is 'Insufficient data' and the engine HALTS.
IF the gap between Inter % and Matric % is more than max_marks_gap points THEN warn the student to check the marks.

then.warn: Big gap between your Matric ({matric_pct}%) and Inter ({inter_pct}%) marks — please check them.

rules.text: IF an MDCAT score is entered and the stream is not Pre-Medical, OR an ECAT/NET score is entered and the stream is Commerce or Humanities THEN warn and ignore that score.

then.warn: MDCAT {value} ignored because your stream is {stream}.
ECAT {value} ignored because your stream is {stream}.
NET {value} ignored because your stream is {stream}.

rules.text: IF any test % is outside pct_min..pct_max, OR the SAT score is outside sat_min..sat_max THEN warn and treat that test as not taken.

then.warn: MDCAT {value} ignored because it is outside {pct_min}–{pct_max}.
ECAT {value} ignored because it is outside {pct_min}–{pct_max}.
NET {value} ignored because it is outside {pct_min}–{pct_max}.
NAT {value} ignored because it is outside {pct_min}–{pct_max}.
LAT {value} ignored because it is outside {pct_min}–{pct_max}.
SAT {value} ignored because it is outside {sat_min}–{sat_max}.

rules.text: IF women-only is Yes and gender is not Female THEN warn and ignore the women-only choice.

then.warn: Women-only choice ({value}) ignored because gender is not Female.

rules.text: IF only the Part-I result is available THEN marks_reliable has CF part1_cf and warn that the marks are an estimate.

then.warn: Your marks are an estimate until your final result (Part-I only).

rules.text: IF Inter % >= band_excellent THEN inter_band = Excellent.
IF band_good <= Inter % < band_excellent THEN inter_band = Good.
IF band_average <= Inter % < band_good THEN inter_band = Average.
IF band_pass <= Inter % < band_average THEN inter_band = Low.
IF Inter % < band_pass THEN inter_band = Very low.
IF MDCAT % >= mdcat_pass_mbbs THEN the MBBS MDCAT pass mark is met.
IF MDCAT % >= mdcat_pass_bds THEN the BDS MDCAT pass mark is met.
IF the final Inter result is available THEN marks_reliable (CF 1.0).
IF the student likes Maths AND is good at solving problems THEN apt_analytical (CF 0.9).
IF the student likes Biology THEN apt_biology (CF 0.85).
IF the student likes computers / coding THEN apt_computing (CF 0.9).
IF the student likes electronics AND Maths THEN apt_electrical (CF 0.85).
IF the student likes machines AND Maths THEN apt_mechanical (CF 0.85).
IF the student likes buildings AND Maths THEN apt_civil (CF 0.85).
IF the student likes drawing AND is creative THEN apt_creative (CF 0.9).
IF the student likes fashion/textiles AND is creative THEN apt_fashion (CF 0.85).
IF the student likes business/money THEN apt_business (CF 0.8).
IF the student likes writing/media AND is a confident communicator THEN apt_media (CF 0.85).
IF the student likes law/debating AND is a confident communicator THEN apt_legal (CF 0.85).
IF the student is interested in how people think and behave THEN apt_people (CF 0.8).
IF the student likes caring for people AND is patient THEN apt_caring (CF 0.85).
IF the student is comfortable in hospitals AND ready for 5+ years of study THEN clinical_ready (CF 0.9).
IF stream is Pre-Medical AND Inter % >= med_min (and marks are reliable) THEN med_academic_ok.
IF med_academic_ok AND the MBBS MDCAT pass mark is met THEN MBBS is eligible.
IF med_academic_ok AND the BDS MDCAT pass mark is met THEN BDS is eligible.
IF med_academic_ok AND MDCAT is not taken yet THEN MBBS and BDS are conditional: after passing MDCAT (MBBS >= mdcat_pass_mbbs%, BDS >= mdcat_pass_bds%).

then.reason: after passing MDCAT (MBBS {mdcat_pass_mbbs}% or more, BDS {mdcat_pass_bds}% or more)
then.plan: Register for MDCAT and aim for at least {mdcat_pass_mbbs}%.

rules.text: IF stream is Pre-Medical AND Inter % >= pharmd_min THEN Pharm-D is eligible.
IF stream is Pre-Medical AND Inter % >= dpt_min THEN DPT is eligible.
IF stream is Pre-Medical AND Inter % >= nursing_min THEN Nursing (BSN) is eligible.
IF stream is Pre-Engineering, OR ICS with Physics, OR Pre-Medical with Additional Maths, AND Inter % >= eng_min THEN Electrical, Mechanical and Civil Engineering are eligible.
IF stream is Pre-Medical AND Additional Maths is not Yes AND Inter % >= eng_min THEN EE, ME and Civil are conditional (PEC 8-week condensed Mathematics programme).

then.reason: PEC lets Pre-Medical students in after an 8-week condensed Mathematics programme
then.plan: Plan for the 8-week condensed Mathematics programme required by PEC.

rules.text: IF the student has a Maths background (Pre-Eng, ICS, Pre-Med with Additional Maths, or Maths at Inter) AND Inter % >= cs_min THEN CS and SE are eligible.
IF the student has no Maths background AND Inter % >= cs_min THEN CS and SE are conditional (6 credit hours of Maths deficiency courses in year 1).

then.reason: you must pass 6 credit hours of Mathematics deficiency courses in the first year
then.plan: Plan for the Mathematics deficiency courses in the first year.

rules.text: IF stream is in arch_streams AND Inter % >= arch_min THEN Architecture is eligible (drawing/aptitude test needed).
IF Inter % >= design_min THEN Fashion/Textile Design and Fine Arts are eligible (portfolio/admission test).
IF Inter % >= business_min THEN BBA and Accounting & Finance are eligible.
IF Inter % >= law_min AND LAT >= lat_pass THEN LLB is eligible.
IF Inter % >= law_min AND LAT is not taken yet THEN LLB is conditional: after passing HEC LAT (>= lat_pass/100).

then.reason: after passing HEC LAT ({lat_pass}/100 or more)
then.plan: Register for HEC LAT and aim for at least {lat_pass}/100.

rules.text: IF Inter % >= socsci_min THEN Media Studies and Psychology are eligible.
IF an MDCAT score is entered AND med_academic_ok AND the BDS pass mark is not met THEN MBBS and BDS are not eligible (MDCAT below the pass mark).

then.reason: MDCAT {mdcat_pct}% is below the pass mark (MBBS {mdcat_pass_mbbs}%, BDS {mdcat_pass_bds}%).

rules.text: FOR EACH field: IF the field has no eligibility fact after the rules above THEN it is not eligible; the reason comes from the field's requirements and the student's data.
IF cs is eligible or conditional AND the student has computing AND analytical aptitude THEN suit.cs (CF 0.9).
IF cs is eligible or conditional AND the student has computing aptitude but NO analytical aptitude THEN suit.cs (CF 0.5).
IF se is eligible or conditional AND the student has computing aptitude AND likes teamwork THEN suit.se (CF 0.8).
IF ee is eligible or conditional AND the student has electrical aptitude THEN suit.ee (CF 0.85).
IF me is eligible or conditional AND the student has mechanical aptitude THEN suit.me (CF 0.85).
IF civil is eligible or conditional AND the student has civil aptitude THEN suit.civil (CF 0.85).
IF mbbs is eligible or conditional AND the student has biology AND caring aptitude AND clinical readiness THEN suit.mbbs (CF 0.9).
IF bds is eligible or conditional AND the student has biology aptitude AND clinical readiness THEN suit.bds (CF 0.75).
IF pharmd is eligible or conditional AND the student has biology aptitude AND likes Chemistry THEN suit.pharmd (CF 0.85).
IF dpt is eligible or conditional AND the student has biology AND caring aptitude THEN suit.dpt (CF 0.75).
IF nursing is eligible or conditional AND the student has caring aptitude AND clinical readiness THEN suit.nursing (CF 0.8).
IF arch is eligible or conditional AND the student has creative aptitude AND likes buildings THEN suit.arch (CF 0.9).
IF fashion is eligible or conditional AND the student has fashion aptitude THEN suit.fashion (CF 0.85).
IF finearts is eligible or conditional AND the student has creative aptitude THEN suit.finearts (CF 0.75).
IF bba is eligible or conditional AND the student has business aptitude AND likes teamwork THEN suit.bba (CF 0.85).
IF af is eligible or conditional AND the student has business AND analytical aptitude THEN suit.af (CF 0.85).
IF media is eligible or conditional AND the student has media aptitude THEN suit.media (CF 0.85).
IF law is eligible or conditional AND the student has legal aptitude THEN suit.law (CF 0.85).
IF psych is eligible or conditional AND the student has people AND caring aptitude THEN suit.psych (CF 0.85).
FOR EACH field: IF suit.F exists AND Pakistan job demand for F is high THEN add agreeing evidence market_high_cf to suit.F.
FOR EACH field: IF suit.F exists AND the student wants to work abroad AND abroad demand for F is high THEN add evidence abroad_cf (x the answer's CF) to suit.F.
FOR EACH field: IF suit.F exists AND Pakistan job demand for F is low THEN add a note (CF unchanged).

then.note: Fewer jobs in Pakistan for {field} right now — see the job outlook.

rules.text: FOR EACH field: IF suit.F >= min_show_cf THEN list the universities offering F (women's universities are left out for male students) and tag each 'required test taken / not yet'.
FOR EACH field: IF Inter % is below an offering's minimum % THEN remove it (strict) and record the reason.
FOR EACH field: IF budget is Low / Medium / High THEN keep fee band low / low+medium / all.
FOR EACH field: IF relocate is not Yes THEN keep only the home city and preferred cities (Not sure: keep others, tagged 'outside your cities').
FOR EACH field: IF hostel is Yes THEN keep only universities with a hostel (Not sure: tag 'check hostel').
FOR EACH field: IF women-only is Yes THEN keep only women's universities (Not sure: list them first).
FOR EACH field: IF sector is not Either THEN keep only that sector.
FOR EACH field: IF the list is empty after UN02-UN07 THEN relax city first, then budget (never the minimum %), and say what was relaxed.
IF the highest suitability CF >= min_show_cf THEN it is recommendation #1.
IF the next highest suitability CF (not already chosen) >= min_show_cf THEN it is recommendation #2.
IF the next highest suitability CF >= min_show_cf THEN it is recommendation #3.
IF no field reaches min_show_cf THEN say 'No strong match yet' and give advice.

then.advice: No strong match yet. Try answering fewer questions with 'Not sure', read the field descriptions, and talk to a career counsellor.

rules.text: IF inter_band is Very low THEN advise improving marks or an associate degree / diploma route.

then.advice: Your Inter marks are below {band_pass}%. Consider an improvement exam (re-appear) or an associate degree / diploma route first.

rules.text: IF any top-3 field is conditional THEN give an action plan (e.g. register for MDCAT or HEC LAT).
FOR EACH field: IF the field is not eligible AND all its aptitudes have CF >= strong_aptitude_cf THEN say 'You seem to like X, but…' and list the closest eligible options.
ALWAYS (after the rules above) write a 2-3 sentence plain-English summary.
